name: Central Holding Group Co. Ltd.
summary: Central Holding Group Co. Ltd. is an investment holding firm based in North Point, Hong Kong since 1996, owned by Central Culture Resource Group Limited and known as Wang Yang Holdings Limited until October 2019. Construction is its core, from foundation works to superstructure, demolition and fitting-out. It also develops and manages property, runs agricultural and food supply chains, sells health and wellness products and trades construction materials.
